natural_body: Price-sensitive SMBs: 40% off drove signup +31%, revenue +18%, retention -12%.

first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% and activation is down 6%, making onboarding simplification the most directly targeted intervention. Prior evidence indicates that shorter onboarding improved completion, time-to-value, and early adoption, while signup-field reduction durably lifted SMB first-week activation. This prioritizes sustainable qualified revenue over a price response that previously reduced retention.
